subject: english-language
title: Word Class Detectives
welcome_lead: Practise spotting word classes in a single sentence.
meta_desc: KS3 English Language adventure on labelling word classes in context.
final_note: You can now label every word in a sentence by class.

concepts.def: Job a word does in a sentence.
Role of a word in context.
Can be more than one class.
Group of words with a verb.

walkthroughs.body_html: 'Run' can be a verb ('I run') or a noun ('a run'). Word class depends on function in the sentence.
In 'The dog bit the man', 'dog' is the subject (doer) and 'man' is the object (receiver).
In 'She quickly opened the small door', label: She (pronoun), quickly (adverb), opened (verb), the (determiner), small (adjective), door (noun).

mcqs.q: The doer of the verb is the...

numericals.q: In 'She opened the door', how many words have a word class?

free_texts.q: The receiver of the verb is the ____.
